faq.q: How much does Ed Bernstein Injury Lawyers charge?
faq.a: Ed Bernstein Injury Lawyers publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Ed Bernstein Injury Lawyers offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Ed Bernstein Injury Lawyers publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Ed Bernstein Injury Lawyers have offices?
faq.a: Ed Bernstein Injury Lawyers publishes two offices, among them Las Vegas. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Ed Bernstein Injury Lawyers?
faq.a: Ed Bernstein Injury Lawyers names five attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Nevada does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Ed Bernstein Injury Lawyers publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Ed Bernstein Injury Lawyers publishes 36 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and entity registration. json_ld_descriptions: I'm Ed Bernstein, and I've been fighting for injured Las Vegas residents since founding my law firm in 1977. Over nearly 50 years, my team and I have achieved a 95% success rate and recovered over $1 billion in settlements and verdicts for our clients, including a $104 million medical negligence verdict and multiple multi-million dollar product liability settlements. We work on a "no fees unless we win" basis and handle all types of personal injury cases—from car accidents and truck crashes to slip and fall injuries, hotel/casino accidents, and defective product claims. My firm includes partner Brian E. Lunt and associate attorney Stacie M. Webb, and we've built our reputation on putting clients first while staying deeply involved in the Las Vegas community. When you're injured, you deserve someone who will fight aggressively for your rights, and that's exactly what we do.
